P0 SOURCE-ONLY IMPLEMENTATION REQUEST, NOT AUTHORIZED TO LAUNCH YET.
Model planned qwen3.8-max, enable_thinking=true, reasoning_effort=xhigh, no thinking_budget together. User authorizes max10 native children each Qwen/DeepSeek parent where safely supported. This direct HTTP route has no tools/children: actual0. No provider execution/import/compile/GPU, globalFactory/PyRe/auth/settings/drivers/product/purchases. Generated source untrusted until ROOT independent static/compiler/runtime admission.

Return strict research JSON status PROPOSED|REFUSED|ANALYSIS, source one complete compact Linux C++17 file<=16000chars, tests_source<=8000chars meaningful pure actual-file receipt/argument tests, analysis/prerequisites/evidence_limits/references bounded arrays. No source duplicated in tests, no placeholder unimplemented code. If complete minimal documented API code cannot fit, honestly REFUSED, not invented P2P PASS. This bounded experiment is intended to discover API support; do not demand already-proven crossvendor physical transport/cache protocol as an artificial prerequisite to attempt documented APIs. No whole giant framework.

Implement ONE selected CUDA GPU -> ONE selected Intel LevelZero ROOT GPU same-process DEVICE allocation DMA-BUF import/copy payload experiment, exactly64KiB payload. No first-device heuristic: explicit CUDA UUID and Intel root UUID, known distinct PCI identities if available; root/subdevice dedup and reject same physical alias. Current host has no Intel enumerated, so hardware NOT_CHECKED; no driver installation or extrapolation from B60Pro to consumer8GBArc. Linux only; Windows handles unsupported NOT_CHECKED2.

Primary pinned documentation available from official CUDA13.4 memory API and LevelZero spec1.19.12:
https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__MEM.html
cuMemGetHandleForAddressRange(void *handle, CUdeviceptr dptr, size_t size, CUmemRangeHandleType handleType, unsigned long long flags): supported DEVICE cuMemAlloc or fully mapped VMM range requires DMA_BUF_SUPPORTED. Address+size host-page-aligned. DMA_BUF_FD output is intFD. PCIe BAR1 flag CU_MEM_RANGE_FLAG_DMA_BUF_MAPPING_TYPE_PCIE succeeds on supported platform or errors. Check attr and API return codes, don't substitute HOST_ALLOC support. Unknown header/entrypoint/version/driver/device support =>NOT_CHECKED, no hardcoded guessed enum values.
https://oneapi-src.github.io/level-zero-spec/level-zero/1.19.12/core/PROG.html
Device allocation import descriptor pNext ze_external_memory_import_fd_t with ZE_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_TYPE_FLAG_DMA_BUF to zeMemAllocDevice is documented. Header local SDK/sdk/include/level_zero/ze_api.h verified c3fb4067e553c31c722cfe934943291b1267402294e7074d34f06b0037ce70de; official tagv1.34.0 sourcecommit934714b278f850d164627eeaaa043eee02785a9e. Runtime loader not yet verified; header/importlib alone is not runtime/Intel driver support.
https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cuda-driver-api/cuda_driver_api/group__CUDA__EXTRES__INTEROP.html
Desktop reverse DMA_BUF import not established; documented CUDA DMABUF import supports Tegra starting Thor. Do not implement Intel-ownedexport -> desktopCUDAimport, and do not infer legal IntelNV sharing from same-UUID CUDA/Vulkan opaque-handle examples. This experiment only NV-owned DEVICE backing exported and Intel imported view; reverse writes/cache visibility not part of this first request.

API sequence should be source-checked and complete: CUDA driver init/version/exactdevice/context, capability attr; choose legal cuMemAlloc backing or fullymapped same-device VMM only if complete bounded source, query actual base/range/alignment and refuse if invalid. Payload64KiB, page-rounded actual allocation/export<=1MiB; record payload vsactual bytes, DEVICE allocation class and CUDA memory properties/owner. Deterministic uint32 pattern generated on CUDA device with independent originalCPU reference retained; source GPU producer --inject-corruption changes exactlyone CUDA deviceword BEFORE export/release/Intel copy, originalCPUexpected unchanged. Full path continues, detects mismatchFAIL1. A CPU staging/refill cannot stand in for GPU dataflow.
Producer cuMemsetD32 constant uint32 pattern and one-wordfault are sufficient actual CUDA device writes, independent CPU original preserved; no giant PTX framework. cuCtxSynchronize producer completion; export exactmappedrange DEVICE DMA_BUF_FD with PCIeBAR1 flag; fstat and robust FD ownership note perAPI, no FD hash invented as backing proof. LevelZero init/intelUUID/selectdriver/context/externalmemoryproperties query actualDMA_BUF import support; imports CUDA FD with correct pNext descriptor then obtains actual allocation properties. Select real supported commandqueuegroup; allocate separate Intel DEVICE target and final hostreadback; append Intel GPU memory copy from imported view into Intel device target, then Intel device-to-final-host readback after correct barrier/event/fence dependencies. Bound host wait10sec, outer ROOT ownedprocess30sec catches native hang. Validate full16384words originalCPUreference, finite counts/bytes/identities/APIstatuses/scope. No host intermediate buffer/refill or CPUcopy between GPUs.

CRITICAL LEGALITY/PROOF LIMIT: CUDA export plus LevelZero import documentation is a hypothesis, not sufficient legal corresponding-resource/cache/alias ownership protocol. Distinguish API capability, import observed, GPU payload observed, actual device backing/residency and physical transport evidence. Completion ordering alone must not be asserted cache-coherence proof. Attempt the documented APIs with their documented FD lifetime, allocation ownership and completion requirements; retain exact unsupported errors. Unresolved physical transport/cache coherence is an explicit experiment limit, not a generic preemptive refusal gate or fabricated success. Host-backed allocations do not qualify DEVICE_P2P. Even payload parity cannot alone prove direct PCIe transport or absent hidden staging: emit scope PAYLOAD_EXPERIMENT_ONLY, direct_transport_qualified=false. Root can later add controller/backing/residence/topology/trace evidence separately.

Clean error/cleanup on every stage: free Intel target/readback/imported view/context/list/queue/event/fence; close FD according to actual transfer semantics, free original CUDA allocation AFTER imported use ends, destroy CUDA context; no double-close/lifetime invalidation. Unknown support returnsNOT_CHECKED2 with exact APIerror; actual attempted copy/native/completion/parity failureFAIL1; success only narrow payload consistency with proof limits, never P2P/fourcapacity PASS. JSON bounded<=128KiB, robust escapedstrings, strictCLIduplicates/unknown/wrongflag refusal. Pure tests discriminate unsupported attrs, aliases, wrongGPU flags, hostclass, producerfault baseline/control binding, cleanupunknown, barequeryP2Pfalseclaim, reversed direction and noIntel; no native test launch or passing actualhardware assertion.
